description: Only if B1 shows the moonshine-wasm single-thread build is unusable (build, bundling, memory, or speed). Port the streaming inference loop from moonshine core (frontend -> sliding-window encoder -> adapter -> cross_kv -> decoder_kv with cached state) to TypeScript on our onnxruntime-web (plain WASM build from A1), loading the same .ort models. Supersedes the original irl-subt-0i6.3.7 plan for community ONNX exports. Close as won't-do if B1 passes.

comments.text: Not needed: the kdl.7 spike passed. The single-thread moonshine-wasm build compiled from the pinned commit, bundles under Vite, loads verified bytes, runs in the Even simulator (WebKitGTK/JSC, no SharedArrayBuffer) within 10% of V8, and is now the live path (kdl.9) with Small at 0.62-0.65 s compute per s of audio and final caption lag p95 < 1 s. Porting the C++ streaming loop to TypeScript on onnxruntime-web would duplicate that and lose the minimal-ORT / exception-trampoline speedups. Reopen only if device runs (kdl.13) show the WASM build failing on Android or iOS.

title: Fallback: TypeScript Moonshine streaming loop on onnxruntime-web
